name: xpath-functions-exslt-str-replace
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
XMLSetContext d namespace {{nsprefix:"str", nsurl:"http://exslt.org/strings"}}
try
XMLXPath r with "str:replace('a-b-c', '-', '+')"
end try
try
XMLXPath r with "str:replace(string(book[1]/title), 'Dick', 'Duck')"
end try
XMLClose d

name: xpath-context-remove
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
XMLSetContext d namespace {{nsprefix:"dc", nsurl:"http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"}} xpath variables {"v", "b1"}
XMLSetContext d namespace {{nsprefix:"dc", nsurl:""}} xpath variables {"v", missing value}
XMLGetContext d
XMLXPath r with "book/dc:creator"
XMLClose d

name: xpath-context-from-list
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.xml")
set e to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.xml")
XMLXPath {XMLRoot d, XMLRoot e} with "$v" xpath variables {"v", 1}
XMLGetContext d
XMLGetContext e
XMLClose d
XMLClose e

name: xpath-node-path-from-root
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
set y to item 1 of (XMLXPath r with "book[2]/year")
XMLGetNodePath y from r
XMLClose d

name: xpath-node-path-from
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
XMLGetNodePath (item 1 of (XMLXPath r with "book[2]/year")) from (XMLChild r index 2)
XMLClose d

name: xptr-relative
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
XMLXPointer "#xpointer(title)" from (XMLChild r index 1)
XMLClose d

name: xptr-no-url
script: set d to XMLOpen from string "B" set {b} to XMLXPointer "#xpointer(/a/b)" from d XMLGetText b XMLClose d

name: xptr-get
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
XMLGetXPointer (XMLChild r index 2)
XMLGetXPointer (XMLChild r index 2) suffix "title"
XMLGetXPointer d
XMLClose d
